checkpoints: A pending/false result schedules another preparation check through the public retry scheduler.
A ready/truthy result clears loading and retryScheduled state and records the token as completed.
Closing the dialog changes visibility but does not itself cancel preparation polling.
Reopening publishes the new token and visible state, then starts a check.
Unmount cleanup cancels any registered retry handle and prevents settled in-flight work from publishing into the unmounted component.
Run the required public JavaScript syntax/build checks after any Action; these checks do not establish business behavior.
forbidden_effects: Do not record or otherwise deliver a file when its preparation result is pending/false.
Do not stop after the first pending result; arrange a later check using the supplied retry API.
Do not treat dialog close as component unmount or silently change close into cancellation.
Do not remove the existing start, close, reopen, or snapshot interface exposed through DownloadDialog's ref.
Do not modify BackgroundExportPanel, tests, configuration, or build metadata for this dialog change.
Do not claim that syntax/build success proves polling or delivery behavior.
lifecycle_identity: The hook/component mount is the lifetime for safe state publication and ownership of a scheduled retry handle.
Each issued check captures the token being checked; a ready result is attributed to that request token.
A scheduled retry is a continuation of pending preparation, while reopen remains an explicit trigger that changes the current token and starts checking it.
Close is a visibility transition within the same mounted lifetime; unmount is the cleanup boundary.

obligations.text: When DownloadDialog preparation returns a pending/false status, keep the preparation workflow alive by scheduling a subsequent check with schedulePreparationRetry.
Do not add the request token to completed while its status is pending; add it only after a ready/truthy status.
Expose polling progress through the existing state shape: a check sets loading and increments checkCount, pending marks retryScheduled, and ready clears loading and retryScheduled.

Retain the existing imperative dialog interface and behavior: start checks the current token, close hides the dialog, reopen selects the supplied token, shows the dialog, and starts checking, and snapshot returns a copied completed array.
Own and clean up the scheduled retry for the mounted DownloadDialog: cancel a registered retry on unmount and prevent an already-issued asynchronous completion from publishing after unmount.
Use the existing preparation API functions rather than introducing a separate timer, transport, or readiness convention.

ordering_barriers: Capture the current request token before issuing checkPreparation so a ready completion is credited to the token actually checked.
On a pending result, register the retry before reporting retryScheduled as true, consistent with the supplied polling implementation.
On a ready result, do not schedule another retry; clear the owned retry handle and publish ready/completed state.
During reopen, assign the next token and restore visibility before invoking the next check.
Unmount cleanup must invalidate later asynchronous publication and cancel any retry handle already registered.
preservation: Preserve DownloadDialog's forwardRef/useImperativeHandle exposure of the preparation object.
Preserve the initial state values and fields: visible, loading, retryScheduled, checkCount, completed, and token.
Preserve check's immediate loading=true, checkCount increment, and publish behavior before the asynchronous transport settles.
Preserve close as visibility-only behavior while mounted.
Preserve reopen's token replacement, visibility restoration, publication, and initiation of a check.
Preserve snapshot isolation for completed by returning a copied array.
scope: Change the file download dialog preparation workflow implemented by src/usePreparation.js and consumed by src/DownloadDialog.jsx.
Use the existing retry and cancellation facilities in src/preparation-api.js.
Treat src/BackgroundExportPanel.jsx as public evidence for the repository's pending-retry and unmount-cleanup conventions, not as a target for migration.

routing_analysis.contract: While DownloadDialog remains mounted, start or reopen initiates a preparation check for the selected token. A false/pending settlement must not complete delivery; it registers a retry through schedulePreparationRetry and reports retryScheduled. A truthy/ready settlement records completion, clears loading and retryScheduled, and does not schedule another retry. Close changes only visibility. Reopen assigns and publishes the new token and visibility before checking. The mounted hook owns its retry handle: unmount invalidates later asynchronous publication and cancels a registered retry. The existing imperative API, state fields, token capture, and copied completed snapshot are preserved.
